settings.aboutContent: Welcome to the official digital voting platform for the 2026 General Elections. FatBallot is engineered to guarantee sovereign transparency, immutable election integrity, and seamless accessibility for all accredited voters. Every vote cast, accreditation processed, and ballot modification is cryptographically signed and permanently logged in our zero-tampering audit ledger. Please ensure your accreditation is active before proceeding to the ballot chamber.

candidates.name: Dr. Adebayo Babatunde Tunde
candidates.tagline: Empowering youth leadership through transparent digital innovation.

Co-founder of Clean Campus Green Initiative
currentOffices: Head of Electoral Ethics Working Group
Senior Member, Council on Digital Governance

Published two peer-reviewed policy briefs on institutional voting trust

candidates.name: Barr. Chioma Grace Okeke
candidates.tagline: Justice, Equity, and Sustainable Community Development.
candidates.vision: Fostering inclusive governance where every registered voter has a direct voice in council policy, with zero tolerance for institutional complacency or administrative opacity.
antecedent: Director of Legal Affairs, Student Union Council (2024)
Lead Counsel in the 2023 Fair Housing Coalition
currentOffices: Liaison Officer to National Academic Body
achievements: Drafted the Historic 2024 Student Bill of Rights
Orchestrated 100% legal aid access for indigent students

candidates.name: Farouk Al-Hassan
candidates.tagline: Bridging the gap between students and administrative leadership.
candidates.vision: To streamline committee coordination, accelerate council resolutions, and guarantee high impact social interventions for every member of our constituency.
antecedent: Organizer of Annual Inter-Faculty Science Olympiad

candidates.name: Omolara Folake Davies
candidates.vision: Transforming the Vice Presidential office into a dynamic engine of student entrepreneurship, mental health advocacy, and community outreach.

candidates.name: Kofi Mensah Boateng
candidates.vision: Digitizing 100% of council archives, implementing open public access to meeting communiques within 24 hours, and setting gold standards for secretarial diligence.

candidates.name: Zainab Aminu Bello
candidates.tagline: Fiscal Integrity and Transparent Treasury Management.
candidates.vision: Publishing monthly itemized treasury dashboards, minimizing bureaucratic budget delays, and optimizing funds to maximize welfare benefits.
currentOffices: Treasurer, Society of Economics and Finance
achievements: Identified and eliminated $12,000 in redundant operational expenses during 2024 audit

candidates.name: Emeka Chibuike Eze
candidates.tagline: Smart budgeting for transformative student development.

achievements: Built the first automated student club dues remittance portal

candidates.name: Stephanie Amara Okon
candidates.tagline: Vibrant community, rich culture, unparalleled welfare.
candidates.vision: Reinvigorating campus life through vibrant cultural festivals, career mixers, and comprehensive health insurance advocacy.
achievements: Organized the largest attended Youth Cultural Festival with 4,500 participants

candidates.name: Tariq Danladi
candidates.tagline: Welfare for all, inclusivity without exception.
candidates.vision: Ensuring no student falls through the cracks by instituting emergency nutrition grants, accessible dormitories, and sports tournaments.
achievements: Renovated 3 common recreational lounges and secured wheelchair ramps

candidates.name: Blessing Ifunanya Uche
candidates.tagline: Amplifying every voice with clarity and truth.
candidates.vision: Transforming the council's communication matrix into an interactive multi-channel hub with weekly podcast briefings, press conferences, and SMS alerts.
antecedent: Digital Media Manager, Model UN Society
achievements: Grew official university news portal audience by 300% within one academic semester

timeline.title: Voter Registration & Database Publication
timeline.description: Publishing of eligible electorate voter lists, RA assignments, and institutional directory cross-matching.

timeline.title: Nomination & Candidate Screening
timeline.description: Submission of candidacy nomination forms, vetting of constitutional eligibility, and publication of contestant profiles.

timeline.title: Presidential & Executive Manifesto Debate
timeline.description: Broadcasted public debate sessions and manifesto presentations streamed live across constituent forums.

timeline.title: Voter Accreditation & Security Verification
timeline.description: Issuance of secure biometric/digital RA authentication tokens and single-device credential validation.

timeline.title: FatBallot Live Election & E-Ballot Portal
timeline.description: Electronic ballot portal opens for accredited voters. Real-time encrypted vote casting with instant change capability.

timeline.title: Official Collation, Audit & Declaration of Results
timeline.description: Cryptographic validation of SHA-256 audit ledger, official return certifications, and swearing-in ceremony.

screeningCriteria.title: Executive Presidential Clearance Benchmark
criteria: Valid constituent matriculation and good financial standing
Zero disciplinary indictment or examination malpractice records
Public asset and constitutional pledge disclosure
Certified leadership track record and public debate participation
Endorsement signatures from at least 25 accredited electorate members

screeningCriteria.title: Vice Presidential Vetting Standards
criteria: Pledge of executive alignment and non-partisanship
Endorsement signatures from at least 15 registered constituents

screeningCriteria.title: General Secretariat Procedural Competence
criteria: Endorsement by at least 10 registered voters
